name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo's motorsport journey began amidst the vibrant racing scene of Buenos Aires, where he spent his youth immersed in the roar of engines and the thrill of competition. He started as a junior mechanic, quickly proving his aptitude for technical details and strategic thinking. His dedication and keen eye for talent led to opportunities in team management, first at a national level and then internationally.

As a sporting director, Mateo is known for his meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to extracting maximum performance from his team. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making. His demanding nature is tempered by a genuine desire to see his team members succeed, making him a respected, if sometimes feared, leader. Mateo is driven by the pursuit of excellence, constantly seeking innovative approaches to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of medium build, Mateo's serious demeanor is offset by a ready smile that appears when discussing racing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with track data and driver notes.
Has a specific brand of mate that he insists on having before every race.
Tends to tap his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often driving colleagues crazy.
